meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入基因名,几秒拿到数据库注释与序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做生物信息研究,经常需要快速查询基因或序列数据
copy.tagline_en: Query gene and sequence databases in seconds
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do bioinformatics research and need fast database lookups.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 gget 命令查询 20 多个生物信息学数据库,获取基因信息、比对 DNA/蛋白质序列、预测蛋白质结构等,并把结果整理成表格或文件返回。
howto.when: 当用户需要快速查询或交互式探索生物信息学数据,如查基因信息、做 BLAST 比对、查蛋白质结构等时,会触发 gget。

say.text: 帮我查一下人类基因 BRCA1 的序列。
say.note: 会用 gget seq 获取该基因的核苷酸序列。

say.text: 用 BLAST 比对这段氨基酸序列。
say.note: 调用 gget blast 搜索相似序列。

say.text: 预测这条蛋白的 AlphaFold 结构。
say.note: 运行 gget alphafold 进行结构预测。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use gget to query 20+ bioinformatics databases for gene info, sequence alignment, protein structures, and more, returning results as tables or files.
howto.when_en: When the user needs quick lookups or interactive exploration of bioinformatics data, such as gene info, BLAST alignment, or protein structures, gget is triggered.

say_en.text: Get the sequence of the human gene BRCA1.
say_en.note: Uses gget seq to fetch the nucleotide sequence.
Calls gget blast for similarity search.

say_en.text: Predict the AlphaFold structure of this protein.
say_en.note: Runs gget alphafold for structure prediction.
